readying: Research construction-robotics: the hub rebuilds what asteroids destroy from its stock.
Load the hub and its 24 cargo bays with the stock listed.
The fuel module makes thruster fuel and oxidizer from chunks (research space-platform-thruster); standing still it meets too few to start, so leave with the thruster's line full.
Fill the reserve tanks with thruster fuel and oxidizer before leaving: in orbit the module fills them slowly (NOTES.md).
Fill each fusion reactor with fusion power cells and its loop with cold fluoroketone, and charge the accumulator and the railguns: a reactor needs power to start (research cryogenic-plant).
Ready it in orbit with the hub stocked: its feed fills the belts and turrets from the hub, so top the hub back up before leaving.
caveats: The trip model reads its rates in straight lines between the starts measured; flown whole, a planned trip brought back more chunks and used less foundation near the edge than planned (NOTES.md).
Flights of 600 s lose little; over a whole trip losses compound, and a load sized to average use did worse flown whole (NOTES.md). Check it with --verify, and carry spares in whole stacks.
The trip starts and ends at the solar system edge: getting there from Nauvis and home again isn't in it (--from nauvis).
